title: Added a `checked` option to a context menu and column menu item. It draws the check mark Handsontable uses for its own toggles and announces the item as a checkbox to assistive technology. It takes a boolean or a function returning one, called with the Handsontable instance as `this`. Note that `checked` is now a reserved item property: a custom item that already carries one holding a boolean or a function is treated as a checkbox from now on.
